verification_command:
(
  set -e
  bun install --frozen-lockfile
  bun run check:release-version
  bun run typecheck
  bun run --cwd apps/vscode-extension lint
  bun run --cwd packages/ui smoke:package

  for lane in heavy-mod heavy-agents unit-1 unit-2 unit-3 dom-1 dom-2 dom-3 dom-4; do
    bun run scripts/ci-test-lane.ts "$lane"
  done

  bun run build
  bun test tests/entry-assets.test.ts packages/ui/components/html-viewer/bridgeAsset.test.ts
)
